ordering_note: Mutation list fixed at Milestone 6.2. Thresholds for Milestone 3.3 were NOT yet finalised at this point — no tuning-to-test-set occurred.

taxonomies.Nouwens2020: Nouwens, M., Liccardi, I., Veale, M., Karger, D., & Kagal, L. (2020). Dark Patterns after the GDPR: Scraping Consent Pop-ups and Demonstrating Their Influence. CHI 2020.
taxonomies.Matte2020: Matte, C., Bielova, N., & Santos, C. (2020). Do Cookie Banners Respect my Choice? Measuring Legal Compliance of Banners from IAB Europe's Transparency & Consent Framework. IEEE S&P 2020.

mutations.name: accept_visual_prominence
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Interface Interference, Asymmetric button styling
mutations.description: Accept button rendered at 2x the font size and contrast of the reject/decline button. Asymmetric visual prominence nudges acceptance.
mutations.dom_field: fontSize, color, fontWeight on CTA buttons

mutations.name: reject_hidden_secondary
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Obstruction, Reject buried in secondary layer
mutations.description: Reject/decline option removed from the primary banner layer and placed only in a Settings sub-page. Primary layer shows only Accept.
mutations.dom_field: has_reject_button on primary layer

mutations.name: preticked_consent_box
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Pre-selection, Opt-in pre-selected
mutations.description: Analytics and marketing consent checkboxes pre-ticked despite requiring explicit opt-in under GDPR Art. 7.
mutations.dom_field: aria-checked, checked property on checkbox inputs

mutations.name: purpose_text_truncation
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Misleading Information, Purpose description hidden behind expand
mutations.description: Purpose descriptions truncated with '...' and collapsed behind a 'Read more' toggle. Full purpose text is hidden on load.
mutations.dom_field: textContent of purpose description elements

mutations.name: zero_width_text_injection
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Misleading Information, Text obfuscation
mutations.description: Zero-width joiners (U+200D) and zero-width non-breaking spaces (U+FEFF) injected into the consent label text. Visually identical but textContent differs.
mutations.dom_field: normalised textContent of all label/button text nodes
mutations.note: Detection requires Unicode normalisation before digest. The MRA normaliser strips zero-width characters.

mutations.name: confirm_shaming_label
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Confirmshaming, Guilt-inducing decline label
mutations.description: Decline button relabelled to 'No thanks, I don't care about my privacy'. Accept button retains neutral label.
mutations.dom_field: accessible name (aria-label / textContent) of decline button

mutations.name: purpose_count_reduction
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Section 4.2 — Fewer purposes shown than declared in TCF
mutations.description: Two IAB TCF purpose descriptions removed from the displayed list while remaining in the TC string. Purpose count mismatch.
mutations.dom_field: count of purpose list-items rendered

mutations.name: vendor_list_suppression
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Section 4.3 — Vendor list hidden or removed
mutations.description: Vendor count badge removed; 'View vendor list' link removed from the banner.
mutations.dom_field: presence of vendor-list navigation link

mutations.name: wall_without_reject
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Obstruction, Cookie wall (no reject option)
mutations.description: Consent banner displayed as a blocking modal with no close or decline affordance. Users must click Accept to proceed.
mutations.dom_field: role=dialog + aria-modal=true, absence of any decline/close button

mutations.name: forced_accept_on_scroll
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Interface Interference, Implied consent via scroll
mutations.description: Banner text changed to 'By scrolling you accept all cookies'. No explicit Accept button provided.
mutations.dom_field: textContent of consent declaration label

mutations.name: toggle_inverted_semantics
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Section 4.4 — Toggle semantics inverted (ON means reject)
mutations.description: Toggle controls inverted: aria-checked=true now means 'rejected', aria-checked=false means 'consented'. Visual label unchanged.
mutations.dom_field: aria-checked value relative to visible label

mutations.name: purpose_label_swap
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Section 4.2 — Purpose label mismatch / mislabelling
mutations.description: Purpose labels for 'Analytics' and 'Advertising' swapped in the DOM while internal TC string retains correct mapping.
mutations.dom_field: textContent of purpose label elements

mutations.name: occlusion_overlay
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Interface Interference, Element occlusion
mutations.description: Transparent 1x1 pixel div overlaid on the reject button with z-index:9999 and pointer-events:all. Button is rendered but physically unclickable.
mutations.dom_field: aria-hidden state, pointer-events computed style, occlusion hit-test

mutations.name: colour_contrast_degradation
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Interface Interference, Insufficient contrast on decline
mutations.description: Decline button text colour changed to #cccccc on #ffffff background (contrast ratio 1.6:1, WCAG AA requires 4.5:1). Text is rendered but illegible.
mutations.dom_field: computed color vs background-color of decline button

mutations.name: accept_all_default_scope
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Section 4.1 — Default scope set to 'all purposes' without indication
mutations.description: All purpose toggles initialised to aria-checked=true (granted) on load before user interaction. No visual indication of pre-selection.
mutations.dom_field: initial aria-checked values of all purpose toggle inputs

mutations.name: duration_omission
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Misleading Information, Consent duration not disclosed
mutations.description: Consent duration text node removed entirely. The banner previously stated '13 months'; that sentence is deleted.
mutations.dom_field: presence of duration/expiry text node

mutations.name: withdraw_link_removal
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Obstruction, Withdraw consent link removed
mutations.description: 'Withdraw consent' or 'Manage preferences' persistent footer link removed. Mechanism to revoke consent no longer accessible.
mutations.dom_field: presence of withdraw/manage-preferences link element

mutations.name: cosmetic_colour_restyle
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Control mutation — no dark-pattern classification
mutations.description: Accept button background colour changed from #1a73e8 to #1565c0 (both WCAG AA compliant, semantics unchanged). This MUST NOT trip the digest.
mutations.dom_field: background-color only, no role/state/text change
mutations.note: Control mutation to confirm the digest does not over-flag cosmetic changes.

mutations.name: aria_role_strip
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Table 1 — Interface Interference, ARIA role removal (accessibility bypass)
mutations.description: role=button removed from styled div elements acting as consent buttons. Elements are visually present but programmatically invisible to assistive technology.
mutations.dom_field: role attribute on button-like interactive elements

mutations.name: purpose_node_reorder
mutations.taxonomy_ref: Section 4.2 — Purpose rendering order differs from TC string declaration order
mutations.description: Purpose list items reordered in the DOM (advertising purpose moved from position 3 to position 1). Order mismatch against declared IAB TCF sequence.
mutations.dom_field: DOM order index of purpose list items
